description: Designs a single screen of a mobile app with the person: send one screen in the design format add_screen builds from and get back a link that opens it in the Architect for the person to change. The link and its code last 7 days. dryRun checks without making a link; format: true returns the format. A whole app is propose_app's.

composition.description: One screen: { name, screen: { content: { children: [node] }, chrome: { header?, headerItems?, floating: [] }, overlays: [] } }. A node is { id, slug, props }: slug is "wireframe:<block>" or a component from find_component.

dryRun.description: check the screen and report, without making a link

into.description: the design code in the person's line

name: propose_screen
title: Propose a screen design
